extraction.Name: Susie McCloskey (also Susan McCloskey Whipple)
extraction.Recorded patent: recorded June 19, 1918, by the Volz Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Susan McCloskey Whipple and Charles Whipple conveyed the land by deed to William Assman for $3000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612699 issued; South half of northeast quarter and north half of southeast quarter section 24, township 98, range 78; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee March 12, 1918; conveyance dated June 18, 1918
